profile.headline: Java Software Developer at SAIC
profile.summary:
Currently working as a software developer at SAIC, updating and maintaining legacy java web applications.
I will finish my Master's of Science in Cybersecurity in May of 2019.

positions.title: Java Software Developer
positions.description:
* Updating and maintaining a legacy java web application.
* Transitioning a web application built in Java 7 to run on Java 8.
* Refactored JSP web interfaces to use React for their front end display and Spring for their REST back end logic. 
* Designed REST endpoints for use by a React based web UI.
* Designed REST interfaces to interact with an Oracle Database. 
* Refactored Oracle queries to be more responsive.
* Transitioned a project from Oracle 10g to use Oracle 12c and written code to take advantage of technical advancements not available when the database was initially designed.
* Wrote and implemented unit tests for a web UI.
* Experience running testing software and unit tests in an automated Jenkins pipeline.

positions.title: Intern
positions.description: Worked on cyber security projects with a focus on utilizing machine learning for the categorization of network security threats.

positions.title: Substitute Math Teacher
positions.description: I performed the regular daily duties of a high school math teacher. I gave formal instruction to students and collected and administered student assessments.

positions.title: Math Teacher
positions.description: I performed the regular duties of a credentialed high school math teacher. I gave daily formal lessons to students and was tasked with differentiating lessons and assessments for students.

positions.description: Lead instructor for a Summer Bridge class of incoming Freshmen to CSUSM.

positions.description: I performed the regular daily duties of a high school math teacher at San Marcos High School and San Dieguito High School Academy. I gave formal instruction to students and was tasked with creating and grading student work and assessments.

positions.title: Aviation Electrical Technician | HH65 Helicopter Mechanic
positions.description:
I performed daily maintenance and repairs on HH65 helicopters for the U.S. Coast Guard. I was regularly tasked with troubleshooting and repairing electrical issues found during flights. 

In 2008 I attended a 4 week C school focused on the troubleshooting and maintenance of the electrical wiring systems of the HH65. In 2009 I attended a different 4 week C school focused on the maintenance and repair of electrical systems and components in the HH65.

While stationed at ATC Mobile I also served as flight crew for the HH65 and flew 1000+ flight hours.

projects.description: I have been writing about my experiments in solving coding challenges at codefights.com.
